about: Control (#9193): a finding whose only long quote is a [doc:] excerpt of an ADR read at the PR head survives. Its code quote is under the 12-character generic-quote floor, so before [doc:] existed the excerpt was scanned as a code quote absent from the diff and the finding was withheld.
pr_body: Adds an invoice total. Implements docs/adr/0001-totals.md.

docs.docs/adr/0001-totals.md:
# Totals

Invoice totals must use checked_add so a sum never wraps.

findings.title: unchecked-total
findings.body: `sum::<u64>` wraps on overflow, against the ADR [doc: docs/adr/0001-totals.md@0123456 — "Invoice totals must use checked_add"].
